title: Define plugin loader, lifecycle, dependency, and hot-reload boundaries before Star parity
description: AstrBot StarManager mixes plugin discovery, metadata parsing, dependency install, dynamic import, hot reload, enable/disable, uninstall, tool cleanup, and platform adapter cleanup. Rust should define these as separate loader/lifecycle/store boundaries before implementing broad plugin loading.

files.change: Define loader orchestration without coupling it to registry, sandbox runtime, or platform extensions.
Parse manifest/metadata independently of loading and activation.
Separate enable, disable, terminate, reload, and unload events from disk discovery.

criteria: The current SDK/sandbox public API remains stable.
Dynamic loading remains deferred unless explicitly scoped.
The design leaves room for both native Rust plugins and Python compatibility bridges.
